title: Open Palm
description: Hold your hand up with all five fingers extended and spread, palm facing the camera. This is one of the signs the app can recognize automatically in Sign Recognition.

title: Closed Fist
description: Curl all fingers into your palm to make a fist, with your thumb resting on the outside of your fingers.

title: Thumbs Up
description: Make a fist and extend your thumb straight upward.

title: Thumbs Down
description: Make a fist and extend your thumb straight downward.

title: Victory / Peace Sign
description: Extend your index and middle fingers in a V shape, keeping the other fingers curled into your palm.

title: Pointing Up
description: Curl all fingers into your palm except your index finger, which points straight up.

title: I Love You
description: Extend your thumb, index finger, and pinky finger, while keeping your middle and ring fingers curled down.

title: ASL: A
description: Make a closed fist with your thumb resting alongside your fingers, not across them.

title: ASL: B
description: Hold your hand flat with fingers together pointing up, thumb folded across your palm.

title: ASL: C
description: Curve your fingers and thumb together to form the shape of the letter C.

title: ASL: D
description: Point your index finger straight up; touch your thumb to your middle finger, with the ring and pinky curled in.

title: ASL: E
description: Curl your fingertips down to rest against your thumb, forming a tight claw-like shape.

title: ASL: F
description: Touch your thumb and index finger together to form a circle, with your other three fingers extended up.

title: ASL: G
description: Point your index finger and thumb out sideways, parallel to each other, with your other fingers curled in.

title: ASL: H
description: Extend your index and middle fingers together, pointing sideways, thumb resting on your curled ring finger.

title: ASL: I
description: Make a fist and extend only your pinky finger straight up.

title: ASL: J
description: Start in the 'I' handshape (pinky extended) and trace the shape of a J in the air.

title: ASL: K
description: Extend your index and middle fingers in a V, with your thumb touching the middle finger's base joint.

title: ASL: L
description: Extend your thumb and index finger to form an L shape, other fingers curled into your palm.

title: ASL: M
description: Tuck your thumb under your index, middle, and ring fingers, with your pinky curled separately.

title: ASL: N
description: Tuck your thumb under your index and middle fingers, with your ring and pinky curled separately.

title: ASL: O
description: Curve all your fingers and thumb to meet at the tips, forming the shape of the letter O.

title: ASL: P
description: Like K but pointed downward: middle finger touches the thumb, index finger extended, hand angled down.

title: ASL: Q
description: Like G but pointed downward: thumb and index finger extended and pointing toward the floor.

title: ASL: R
description: Cross your index and middle fingers, other fingers curled, thumb holding down the ring and pinky.

title: ASL: S
description: Make a closed fist with your thumb wrapped across the front of your fingers.

title: ASL: T
description: Make a fist with your thumb tucked between your index and middle fingers.

title: ASL: U
description: Extend your index and middle fingers together pointing up, other fingers curled, thumb holding them down.

title: ASL: V
description: Extend your index and middle fingers in a V shape (like a peace sign), other fingers curled down.

title: ASL: W
description: Extend and spread your index, middle, and ring fingers, thumb holding down your pinky.

title: ASL: X
description: Curl your index finger into a hook shape, other fingers curled into your palm, thumb resting alongside.

title: ASL: Y
description: Extend your thumb and pinky finger out to the sides, other three fingers curled ('hang loose' shape).

title: ASL: Z
description: Extend your index finger and trace the shape of the letter Z in the air.
